## Adversarial Claim Verifier (voter 1/3)

Be SKEPTICAL. Try to REFUTE this claim. ≥2/3 refutations kill it.

## Research question
State of the art (as of July 2026) in AI coding-agent governance and harness design — the problem space of the claude.md-workflow repo: project instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style), lifecycle hooks, deterministic verification gates, persistent agent memory/working-state across sessions and compaction, behavioral guardrails against scope creep/overclaiming/sycophancy, git-level enforcement, task contracts, and parallel multi-agent orchestration (worktree isolation, orchestrator/reduce patterns, adversarial review). Survey and compare best practices from: Anthropic (Claude Code, Agent SDK, skills/hooks/subagents), OpenAI (Codex, AGENTS.md), Google (Gemini CLI/Jules/Antigravity), Microsoft (GitHub Copilot agents, AutoGen/agent frameworks), NVIDIA (agent toolkits/NeMo), xAI (Grok agents/coding); and non-Western labs: Moonshot AI (Kimi K2.5 agentic training), Zhipu/Z.ai (GLM-5.x coding agents), DeepSeek (agentic/tool-use practices), Tencent (recent Hunyuan model launch and agent tooling), MiniMax (M-series agentic models), Alibaba Qwen if relevant; plus respected independents: Nous Research (Hermes 4/Hermes agent), Fundamental Research Labs (Peter Wang co-founder), the team behind the Ornith-1.0 LLM, tinygrad/George Hotz's approach to minimal harnesses, and any other influential open agent-harness projects (e.g. OpenHands, SWE-agent, Aider, Cline, Devin/Cognition). For each: what they prescribe for instruction-file structure and length, memory persistence, verification/eval gating, multi-agent patterns, and prompt-vs-deterministic enforcement. Identify convergent consensus, notable divergences (especially Western vs Chinese lab practices), and concrete, citable insights that should shape a 2026 rewrite of a drop-in governance kit for coding agents. Note if any named entity cannot be verified to exist (e.g. 'Ornith-1.0') rather than guessing.

## Claim under review
"Zhipu AI explicitly frames GLM-5 as a paradigm shift from 'vibe coding' to 'agentic engineering', i.e., positioning the model for autonomous end-to-end software engineering rather than interactive assisted coding."

**Source:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15763 (primary)
**Supporting quote:** "We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering."

## Checklist
1. Is the claim actually supported by the quote, or is it an overreach/misread?
2. WebSearch for contradicting evidence — does any credible source dispute or heavily qualify this?
3. Is the source quality sufficient for the claim's strength? (extraordinary claims need primary sources)
4. Is the claim outdated? (check dates — old claims about fast-moving fields are suspect)
5. Is this a marketing claim / press release / cherry-picked benchmark / forum speculation?

**refuted=true** if: unsupported by quote / contradicted / low-quality source for strong claim / outdated / marketing fluff.
**refuted=false** ONLY if: claim is well-supported, current, and source quality matches claim strength.
Default to refuted=true if uncertain.

Structured output only. Evidence MUST be specific.

# GLM-5 Paper Summary

**Title:** GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

**Authors/Organization:** GLM-5-Team (185 authors including Aohan Zeng, Jie Tang, and others from affiliated institutions)

**Submission Date:** February 17, 2026 (v1); February 24, 2026 (v2)

**Abstract Quote:**
"We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering. Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor, GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity."

The abstract further notes that the model features novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms and demonstrates "unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges."

Web search results for query: "GLM-5 Zhipu "vibe coding" "agentic engineering""

Links: [{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://arxiv.org/html/2602.15763v1"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering GLM-5 Team","url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - ar5iv - arXiv","url":"https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5: Frontier Leap of Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - Webkul Blog","url":"https://webkul.com/blog/glm-5/"},{"title":"(PDF) GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://www.researchgate.net/publication/400895075_GLM-5_from_Vibe_Coding_to_Agentic_Engineering"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - Handout","url":"https://www.secs.oakland.edu/~tianlema/ai/lectures/L10/handout.html"},{"title":"[2602.15763] GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15763"},{"title":"Paper page - GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://huggingface.co/papers/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5’s Journey into Agentic Engineering | by Miles K. | Jun, 2026 | Medium","url":"https://medium.com/@milesk_33/glm-5s-journey-into-agentic-engineering-ed8526fd2dd7"}]

Based on the search results, here's what I found about GLM-5, Zhipu AI, "vibe coding," and "agentic engineering":

## Overview

GLM-5 is a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering, presented by Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University.

## Announcement and Scale

Zhipu AI announced GLM-5 on February 11, 2026. GLM-5 is a Mixture-of-experts (MOE) model with 744B total parameters with 40B used at once, compared to 355B total and 32B active in GLM-4.5.

## Key Technical Features

GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity. It implements a new asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure that improves post-training efficiency by decoupling generation from training, along with novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms that improve RL quality and enable the model to learn from complex, long-horizon interactions.

## Philosophical Shift

The philosophy shift is depicted in the tagline "From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering," where previous models were good at quick and creative vibe-based coding, while GLM-5 focuses on long-standing and reliable agents that can handle tool use and long-chain performance.

## Performance

GLM-5 demonstrates unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges.

The claim's gloss (autonomous end-to-end SWE vs interactive assisted coding) is directly supported by the abstract's further statement that GLM-5 shows "unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges."
